guide_target.label: 二重影（2000年オリジナルPC版）

routes.title: 桔梗ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 桔梗 END by the directly inspected SagaoZ walkthrough. The same walkthrough also documents a 桔梗 BAD END detour near the final-day heroine choice. This route is the source walkthrough's first full playthrough and establishes shared save points used to shorten later heroine clears.

routes.title: 命ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 命 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from the shared セーブ1, deliberately builds the early 紗枝-affinity state documented by both primary sets so BIGLOBE's 紗枝エンド detour is actually reachable, then uses セーブ3 to return and continue the 命-oriented completion path. It also documents 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, 命 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END detours.

routes.title: 楓玲ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 楓玲 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from セーブ5 created during the 命 path via 何もいわない and documents a 楓玲 BAD END before the main 楓玲 END. BIGLOBE independently establishes the highest-affinity heroine ending structure and explicitly states that すまん is presented only on the 命 route, corroborating the split without printing SagaoZ's opposite branch wording.

sources.title: 二重影 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Primary Set A. Directly inspected complete Japanese walkthrough for ケロQ 二重影. It explicitly reports 確認バージョン「修正なし」 and 状況「完了（ＣＧ・回想１００％）」, and contains separate 桔梗・命・楓玲 sections with movement/action sequences, timed choices, saves, heroine bad ends, main heroine ends, 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END.

sources.title: 二重影攻略 - BIGLOBE
sources.notes: Primary Set B. Independent directly inspected 12-day Japanese walkthrough. It documents the day-by-day navigation/action flow, heroine-affection choices (including 桔梗・命・楓玲 and 紗枝), the day-11 final quiz, heroine selection by highest affection, the 陵辱 vs ハッピー ending branch, and the Il-Sui rescue/failure sequence. Its route presentation differs substantially from SagaoZ, providing an independent cross-check rather than a derivative copy.

disagreements: RESEARCH GATE SATISFIED: SagaoZ is Set A and the independent BIGLOBE walkthrough is Set B. The guides use different optimization strategies: SagaoZ provides exact completion paths and save reuse, while BIGLOBE presents a 12-day framework with heroine-affinity annotations and ending rules. The guide therefore keeps branch/state-affecting choices, source-documented saves, non-main ending detours, the final quiz, and ending interactions; repeated/common navigation and combat that do not define the route are not promoted into route steps. BIGLOBE independently supports the 桔梗/命/楓玲 affinity structure, the eight-answer final quiz, highest-affinity heroine selection, the ～は俺と来い 陵辱 branch, the ～は十兵衛と一緒に行け happy branch, and the Il-Sui rescue/failure sequence. The 命 section preserves SagaoZ's early 紗枝-affinity setup through セーブ3 so BIGLOBE's one-set 紗枝エンド detour is reachable; after loading セーブ3 the guide takes 励ますだけにする and continues the main path. SagaoZ's 命 completion path deliberately takes some choices BIGLOBE annotates as 楓玲 affinity (including 変な解釈するな, 考え過ぎだな, and 絶対に呪いを解いてやる); those are retained rather than rewritten because the primary completion path still reaches 命 END. For the 楓玲 split, SagaoZ prints 何もいわない from セーブ5 while BIGLOBE prints that すまん occurs only on the 命 route and independently documents the highest-affinity heroine ending system; this difference is preserved rather than fabricating an exact Set-B copy of 何もいわない. BIGLOBE describes ～は俺と来い as 陵辱エンド and ～は十兵衛と一緒に行け as ハッピーエンド; SagaoZ labels the corresponding outcomes [heroine] BAD END and [heroine] END. The repeated three-question interrogation printed by SagaoZ on each final arm is retained with the permitted Set-B omission marker because BIGLOBE summarizes the ending branch without printing those repeated prompts. ENTRY: 桔梗 begins at SagaoZ's Day-1 セーブ1 after the shared prologue; BIGLOBE begins its table at Day 1, so the pre-route timed prologue action is not emitted. TARGET: original 2000 Windows PC product family, not the later console ports. Supplementary Destiny-Tiar and FTcom discoveries remain provenance only because their full pages are not directly inspectable in the current fetch path.
